Modified for TWOH: the rectangle triangulation and winding from
portal/GeometryPortalShape.java are adapted in RiftAperture; the directed
segment/plane intersection from portal/Portal.java is adapted in RiftCrossing.
The adapted classes do not import the upstream runtime.

TWOH also contains a relocated portion of the Forge 0.17 runtime (CurseForge file
3562072). The classes in com.inza.twoh.portalcore are modified from upstream:
private package/resource/channel names, TWOH lifecycle, no separate Forge mod,
commands, peripheral mixins, alternate worlds or vanilla portal replacement.
The Embeddium chunk listener adapter is specific to TWOH. Original copyright
2020 qouteall. Apache-2.0.txt applies to the upstream-derived portions.
